title: Online Syllabus - KIT's College of Engineering Kolhapur
text:
ONLINE SYLLABUS — KITCOEK

KITCOEK provides online access to the complete syllabus for all programs under three schemes:

SCHEMES AVAILABLE
1. 2023 Scheme (NEP-2020) — Current scheme as per National Education Policy 2020
2. 2021 Cycle-2 — Previous cycle under Shivaji University autonomous structure
3. 2017 Cycle-1 — Earlier cycle

PROGRAMS COVERED
B.Tech. (Bachelor of Technology):
- First Year (FY B.Tech.) — Common for all branches
- Second Year (SY B.Tech.) — Branch-specific
- Third Year (TY B.Tech.) — Branch-specific
- Final Year (BE / B.Tech.) — Branch-specific

M.Tech. (Master of Technology):
- First Year M.Tech.
- Second Year M.Tech.

BRANCHES WITH SYLLABUS AVAILABLE
- Biotechnology Engineering
- Civil Engineering
- Civil and Environmental Engineering
- Computer Science and Engineering (CSE)
- Computer Science and Business Systems (CSBS)
- Computer Science Engineering — AI & ML (CSE-AIML)
- Electrical Engineering
- Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering (E&TC)
- Mechanical Engineering
- Basic Sciences and Humanities

HOW TO ACCESS SYLLABUS
Visit https://www.kitcoek.in/online-syllabus, select your Scheme, Academic Level (B.Tech/M.Tech), Academic Year, and Branch to download the Structure and Syllabus PDF documents.

All syllabi are approved by the Board of Studies (BoS) and Academic Council of KITCOEK Autonomous Institute.
